channel.title: Enhancerworx Blog
channel.description: Study guides, programming tutorials and learning-app advice from Enhancerworx.

item.title: How to learn the map of India for UPSC, SSC and state exams
item.description: A step-by-step method to learn India's map for competitive exams: build a frame, add layers, practise recall on blank maps and revise with spaced repetition.

item.title: How to memorise world flags and capitals: 7 techniques that work
item.description: Learn the world's flags and capitals faster with seven proven techniques: group by region, spot flag families, learn the tricky capitals and test yourself.

item.title: 12 Git commands every beginner should know
item.description: The Git commands you will actually use every day, explained in plain English with examples, plus how to fix the most common beginner mistakes.

item.title: Docker explained for beginners: images, containers and your first app
item.description: What Docker is, how images and containers differ, how containers compare with virtual machines, and the commands to run and build your first container.

item.title: How to study biology diagrams for board exams and NEET
item.description: A practical routine for learning biology diagrams: understand function first, draw from memory, label with blanks, use colour and practise the diagrams examiners ask most.

item.title: Planning a learning app for your school or institute: a checklist
item.description: What to decide before you build an educational app: learners and outcomes, content, offline use, platforms, assessments, privacy, budget and ownership.
